name: Planmaster Wyncote
title: Planmaster of the Court of the Unfinished Plan
role: This season's Planmaster of the Making — won the contest with a better plan for the Half-Cathedral's north aisle, and governs until someone draws a better one
appearance: A cheerful man with graphite on both hands and a plan rolled under his arm, who keeps glancing up at the scaffolding as if it might have improved while he wasn't looking.
voiceHints: Quick and delighted. Interrupts himself with a better idea. Says 'not yet' where other people say 'no'.
wants: To be beaten at next season's contest by a plan so good he wishes he had drawn it.
fears: That the Ceaseless build over the Forge-Eternal before anyone has time to draw the next plan.
knowledge: Every plan laid before the Court for twenty seasons, and why each one lost
Where the Ceaseless will build next, roughly, and why he cannot stop them

reactsToReputation.reliable: shows you the plan for next season
reactsToReputation.reckless: asks you, kindly, not to touch the scaffolds

questSeeds: A plan has been laid before the Court that would finish the Half-Cathedral, and the Court does not know what to do with it
The Ceaseless have started building on Greenforge's timber yard
gear: a drafting case of well-used tools
_domainsWhy: making that never finishes, the pattern in a plan, and stone that holds it up
